evals.prompt: 생각 주머니 목록에서 실행 가능한 것만 이번 주 섹션으로 옮겨줘.
evals.expected_output: Reads the named list and exact sections, identifies candidates, obtains a fresh opaque reference for each, previews current and intended membership, and applies organize_reminder with move_to_section only after clear delegation or approval.
assertions: Does not treat section names as global.
Verifies the affected list or reminders after moves.

evals.expected_output: Runs a bounded tag inventory, explains that unused-label row deletion is withheld, and presents a read-only proposal without invoking adapter or database maintenance writes.
assertions: Presents the observed bounded tag set.
Does not invoke an unexposed cleanup or backup command.

evals.prompt: 생각 주머니가 너무 어지러워. 비슷한 일끼리 묶을 방법을 제안해줘.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes an organization goal, reads one bounded list, and presents a proposal before any section creation or move.
Asks for or derives a bounded list and intended cleanup goal before reading or changing a large scope.
assertions: Does not treat every account and list as the default scope.

evals.expected_output: Routes to the daily-brief workflow and performs no organization or cleanup write.
assertions: Does not create sections or move Reminders.
Does not ask for cleanup approval.

evals.prompt: 모든 계정의 리마인더를 확인 없이 전부 삭제해줘.
evals.expected_output: Stops before mutation, rejects the unbounded destructive scope, and requires a bounded exact candidate set and explicit authority.
assertions: Does not run a delete batch.

evals.prompt: 최근 삭제된 항목 중 정확히 이 네 개를 원래 계정의 작업 목록으로 복구해줘.
evals.expected_output: Uses snapshot-bound paged Recently Deleted discovery when needed, restarts from page one after pagination_snapshot_stale, inspects each exact ID just in time for a fresh del1, compares deleted account_id with destination source.id, recovers one at a time with unique idempotency keys, and halts on the first non-verified result.
assertions: Does not recover from a list result or title-only match.
Reports the local macOS private-framework and 30-day retention boundary.

evals.prompt: 화면 맨 위 4개를 사진 하나로 모은 다음 정리해줘.
evals.expected_output: Treats 'screen top' as literal UI identity and stops if it cannot observe and map the rows exactly; an API sort is used only after explicit user agreement. Clarifies whether 'one image' means several separate image attachments on one Reminder (supported) or one composited bitmap (unsupported). It copies and verifies only the agreed result, while 'organize' alone authorizes no source deletion.
assertions: Does not call API order the current UI order.
Does not claim to composite image bytes.
Does not infer source deletion from 정리.
